items.name: Aguascalientes
alt: Free and Sovereign State of Aguascalientes
items.blurb: Aguascalientes, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Aguascalientes, is one of the 32 states which comprise the federated entities of Mexico. At 22°N and with an average altitude of 1,950 m above sea level it is predominantly of semi-arid climate.

items.name: Baja California
alt: Free and Sovereign State of Baja California
Free and Sovereign State of Lower California
items.blurb: Baja California, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Baja California, is a state in Mexico. It is the northwesternmost of the 32 federal entities of Mexico.

items.name: Baja California Sur
items.blurb: Baja California Sur, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Baja California Sur, is a state in Mexico. It is the 31st and last state to be admitted, in 1974.

items.name: Campeche
items.blurb: Campeche, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Campeche, is one of the 31 states which, with Mexico City, make up the 32 federal entities of Mexico.

items.name: Chiapas
items.blurb: Chiapas, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Chiapas, is one of the states that make up the 32 federal entities of Mexico. It comprises 124 municipalities as of September 2017 and its capital and largest city is Tuxtla Gutiérrez.

items.name: Chihuahua
items.blurb: Chihuahua, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Chihuahua is one of the 31 states which, along with Mexico City, are the 32 federal entities of Mexico.

items.name: Coahuila
items.blurb: Coahuila, formally Coahuila de Zaragoza, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Coahuila de Zaragoza, is one of the 31 states of Mexico.

items.name: Colima
alt: Free and Sovereign State of Colima
Estado Libre y Soberano de Colima
items.blurb: Colima, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Colima, is among the 31 states that make up the 32 federated entities of Mexico. It shares its name with its capital and main city, Colima.

items.name: Durango
alt: Free and Sovereign State of Durango
items.blurb: Durango, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Durango, is one of the states which make up the 32 federal entities of Mexico, situated in the northwest portion of the country.

items.name: Guanajuato
items.blurb: Guanajuato, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Guanajuato, is one of the 32 states that make up the Federal Entities of Mexico. It is divided into 46 municipalities and its capital city is Guanajuato.

items.name: Guerrero
alt: Free and Sovereign State of Guerrero
items.blurb: Guerrero, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Guerrero, is one of the 31 states that compose the 32 Federal Entities of Mexico. It is divided into 85 municipalities.

items.name: Hidalgo
alt: Free and Sovereign State of Hidalgo
items.blurb: Hidalgo, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Hidalgo, is one of the 31 states which, along with Mexico City, constitute the 32 federal entities of Mexico.

items.name: Jalisco
alt: Free and sovereign state of Jalisco
items.blurb: Jalisco, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Jalisco, is one of the 31 states which, along with Mexico City, comprise the 32 Federal Entities of Mexico. It is located in western Mexico and is bordered by six states, Nayarit, Zacatecas, Aguascalientes, Guanajuato, Michoacán, and Colima.

items.name: Mexico City
items.blurb: Mexico City is the capital and largest city of Mexico, as well as the most populous city in North America. It is one of the world's leading cultural and financial centers and, according to the Globalization and World Cities Research Network's 2024 ranking, is classified as an Alpha world city.

items.name: Michoacán
items.blurb: Michoacán, formally Michoacán de Ocampo, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Michoacán de Ocampo, is one of the 31 states which, together with Mexico City, compose the Federal Entities of Mexico.

items.name: Morelos
items.blurb: Morelos, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Morelos, is a landlocked state located in south-central Mexico. It is one of the 32 states which comprise the Federal Entities of Mexico.

items.name: Nayarit
alt: Free and Sovereign State of Nayarit
items.blurb: Nayarit, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Nayarit, is one of the 31 states that, along with Mexico City, comprise the Federal Entities of Mexico. It is divided in 20 municipalities and its capital city is Tepic.

items.name: Nuevo León
alt: Free and Sovereign State of Nuevo León
Free and Sovereign State of Nuevo Leon
items.blurb: Nuevo León, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Nuevo León, is a state in northeastern Mexico. The state borders the Mexican states of Tamaulipas, Coahuila, Zacatecas, and San Luis Potosi, and has an extremely narrow international border with the U.S. state of Texas.

items.name: Oaxaca
alt: Estado Libre y Soberano de Oaxaca
items.blurb: Oaxaca, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Oaxaca, is one of the 31 states of Mexico. It is divided into 570 municipalities, of which 418 are governed by the system of usos y costumbres with recognized local forms of self-governance.

items.name: Puebla
alt: Free and Sovereign State of Puebla
items.blurb: Puebla, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Puebla, is one of the 31 states that, along with Mexico City, comprise the Federal Entities of Mexico. It is divided into 217 municipalities and its capital is Puebla City.

items.name: Querétaro
items.blurb: Querétaro, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Querétaro, is one of the 32 federal entities of Mexico. It is divided into 18 municipalities. Its capital city is Santiago de Querétaro.

items.name: Quintana Roo
alt: Free and Sovereign State of Quintana Roo
items.blurb: Quintana Roo, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Quintana Roo, is one of the 31 states which, along with Mexico City, constitute the 32 federal entities of Mexico.

items.name: San Luis Potosí
items.blurb: San Luis Potosí, officially the Free and Sovereign State of San Luis Potosí, is one of the 32 states which compose the Federal Entities of Mexico. It is divided in 59 municipalities and is named after its capital city, San Luis Potosí.

items.name: Sinaloa
items.blurb: Sinaloa, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Sinaloa, is one of the 31 states which, along with Mexico City, compose the Federal Entities of Mexico. It is divided into 20 municipalities, and its capital and largest city is Culiacán Rosales.

items.name: Sonora
items.blurb: Sonora, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Sonora, is one of the 31 states which, along with Mexico City, comprise the Federal Entities of Mexico. The state is divided into 72 municipalities.

items.name: State of Mexico
items.blurb: The State of Mexico, officially Mexico, is one of the 32 federal entities of the United Mexican States. Sharing its name with both the country and the national capital, Mexico City, the state is colloquially distinguished as Edomex.

items.name: Tabasco
items.blurb: Tabasco, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Tabasco, is one of the 32 federal entities of Mexico. It is divided into 17 municipalities and its capital city is Villahermosa.

items.name: Tamaulipas
items.blurb: Tamaulipas, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Tamaulipas, is a state in Mexico; it is one of the 31 states which, along with Mexico City, comprise the 32 federated entities of Mexico.

items.name: Tlaxcala
items.blurb: Tlaxcala, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Tlaxcala, is one of the 32 federal entities that comprise the Federal Entities of Mexico. It is divided into 60 municipalities and the capital city and the largest city is Tlaxcala de Xicohténcatl.

items.name: Veracruz
alt: Veracruz de Ignacio de la Llave
items.blurb: Veracruz, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Veracruz de Ignacio de la Llave, is one of the 31 states that, along with Mexico City, comprise the 32 Federal Entities of Mexico.

items.name: Yucatán
items.blurb: Yucatán, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Yucatán, is one of the 31 states which, along with Mexico City, constitute the 32 federal entities of Mexico.

items.name: Zacatecas
alt: Free and Sovereign State of Zacatecas
items.blurb: Zacatecas, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Zacatecas, is one of the 31 states of Mexico. It is divided into 58 municipalities and its capital city is Zacatecas.
